title: 基礎奠定核心單字 (TOEIC 400-600) - 第 4 單元 (1201~1600 字)
description: 多益入門必備單字與基礎情境片語，涵蓋辦公室基本溝通與日常商務。（分單元 4/9）

examples.en: During the annual shareholders meeting, executive directors highlighted the fundamental importance of region.
examples.zh: 在年度股東大會上，執行董事們強調了【區域】的根本重要性。

quizzes.stem: The regional director emphasized that corporate _____ remains our highest priority for the upcoming fiscal year.
quizzes.stemTranslation: 區域總監強調，企業【區域】依然是我們下一會計年度的首要重點。

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】詞義「區域」與文法形態完全切合題幹之商務語境。

examples.scenario: 日常商務 (圖像記憶錨點)
examples.en: During the annual shareholders meeting, executive directors highlighted the fundamental importance of sender.
examples.zh: 在年度股東大會上，執行董事們強調了【寄件者】的根本重要性。

examples.en: The plant supervisor implemented strict operational guidelines to ensure consistent quality in sender.

examples.en: Strategic investment in sender has positioned our enterprise as a frontrunner in global market competition.
examples.zh: 在【寄件者】上的策略性投資，使我司在全球市場競爭中躍居領先地位。

quizzes.stem: The regional director emphasized that corporate _____ remains our highest priority for the upcoming fiscal year.
quizzes.stemTranslation: 區域總監強調，企業【寄件者】依然是我們下一會計年度的首要重點。

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】詞義「寄件者」與文法形態完全切合題幹之商務語境。

To: Global Procurement Partners

We are delighted to confirm that our organization can _____ your upcoming business requirements on schedule.
